The suppression lists of the mail service

suppression_lists.Rd

SendGrid keeps five lists of addresses per user. Four of them suppress: a send to an address on them answers 202 and does not leave, so the channel counts as delivered a message nobody receives. The fifth, Blocks, does not: measured on 2026-11-10, a block does not stop the next send, which may get through. So the four are judged as a state (the address is on the list today) and Blocks only as an event (an entry created in the last hours).

Usage

suppression_lists()

Value

A data frame with lista, the path under /v3/suppression/ and the name the code uses; nome, the name the console shows; and sopprime, whether a send to an address on it is dropped.

Details

One list for the reader, the matcher and the mail to IT, so the path the API is asked on and the name the console shows cannot drift apart.
